🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
tanh计算双曲正切值
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)
ts_rank滚动排名（当前值在 n 期窗口内的百分位排名）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 high：high
  4. 计算 low：low
  5. 计算 mom：close / close.shift(5) - 1
  6. 计算 range_ratio：(high - low) / close
  7. 计算 range_vol：range_ratio.滚动窗口(10, min_periods=5).std()
  8. 计算 range_vol_mean：range_vol.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).mean()
  9. 计算 range_vol_std：range_vol.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
  10. 计算 vol_z：(range_vol - range_vol_mean) / range_vol_std
  11. 计算 vol_z_clipped：np.clip(vol_z, -2, 2)
  12. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  13. 计算 ema_ret：ret.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10, adjust=False).mean()
  14. 计算 persistence：np.clip(ema_ret * 3, -1, 1)
  15. 计算 vol_rank：volume.滚动窗口(20).rank(pct=True)
  16. 计算 vol_ma20：volume.滚动窗口(20).mean()
  17. 计算 vol_trend：volume.滚动窗口(5).mean() / vol_ma20
  18. 计算 confidence：1 + np.tanh(vol_rank * vol_trend)
  19. 计算 base：mom / (1 + vol_z_clipped.abs()) * (1 + persistence)
  20. 计算 factor：base * confidence
  21. 计算 factor：factor.clip(-5, 5)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volume_gated_momentum_mutated_v3(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] "com"># Core momentum: 5-day "kw">class="kw">return mom = close / close.shift(5) - 1 "com"># Range-based volatility: rolling std of high-low range / close over 10 days range_ratio = (high - low) / close range_vol = range_ratio.rolling(10, min_periods=5).std() range_vol_mean = range_vol.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean() range_vol_std = range_vol.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1) vol_z = (range_vol - range_vol_mean) / range_vol_std.replace(0, np.nan) vol_z_clipped = np.clip(vol_z, -2, 2) "com"># Trend persistence: EMA of returns with span 10, clipped ret = close.pct_change() ema_ret = ret.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() persistence = np.clip(ema_ret * 3, -1, 1) "com"># Volume components: rank percentile "kw">class="kw">and trend ratio vol_rank = volume.rolling(20).rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) vol_ma20 = volume.rolling(20).mean() vol_trend = volume.rolling(5).mean() / vol_ma20.replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Confidence: multiplicative product mapped to [0,2] via tanh confidence = 1 + np.tanh(vol_rank * vol_trend) "com"># Base factor: momentum adjusted by volatility "kw">class="kw">and persistence base = mom / (1 + vol_z_clipped.abs()) * (1 + persistence) "com"># Final factor factor = base * confidence factor = factor.fillna(0.0).clip(-5, 5) df_copy["str">'factor_volume_gated_momentum_mutated_v3'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_volume_gated_momentum_mutated_v3']
